claims.title: Unit-step complex-power integral bound and Hermitian Gram expansion of the dual column norm
claims.hypotheses: Real x > 0, complex exponent z ∈ ℂ (z ≠ 0 for the slit-plane integral identity, Re z > 0 for the endpoint power bound), and integers n ≥ U ≥ 1 for the unit-step complex-power bound; arbitrary finite index sets S and I, complex coefficients b : I → ℂ, row entries v : S × I → ℂ, row outputs s_i = ∑_{n∈I} b(n) v_i(n), dual column w(n) = ∑_{i∈S} conj(s_i) v_i(n), Gram entries G_{i,j} = ∑_{n∈I} v_i(n) conj(v_j(n)), and real row-sum bound Δ ≥ 0 satisfying ∑_{j∈S} |G_{i,j}| ≤ Δ for every i ∈ S.
claims.statement: For every real x > 0, x^(−z) − (x + 1)^(−z) = z ∫_x^(x+1) t^(−z−1) dt whenever z ≠ 0 and |x^(−z) − (x + 1)^(−z)| ≤ |z| x^(−Re z − 1) whenever Re z > 0, so |(n + 1)^(−z) − n^(−z)| ≤ |z|/U for all integers n ≥ U ≥ 1 when Re z > 0; and on finite sets S and I, G_{j,i} = conj(G_{i,j}), ∑_{n∈I} |w(n)|² = ∑_{i∈S} ∑_{j∈S} conj(s_i) s_j G_{i,j} ≤ Δ ∑_{i∈S} |s_i|², and ∑_{i∈S} |s_i|² ≤ Δ ∑_{n∈I} |b(n)|².
definitions: row outputs s_i = ∑_{n∈I} b(n) v_i(n) (i ∈ S) and dual column w(n) = ∑_{i∈S} conj(s_i) v_i(n) (n ∈ I)
Hermitian Gram matrix G_{i,j} = ∑_{n∈I} v_i(n) conj(v_j(n)) on S × S with absolute row-sum bound Δ ≥ 0

claims.correspondence: Slit-plane integration of −z t^(−z−1) over [x, x + 1] and left-endpoint monotonicity of t^(−Re z − 1) establish the unit-step complex-power bound; Fubini interchange on S × S × I and Hermitian symmetry |G_{j,i}| = |G_{i,j}| expand and bound ∑_{n∈I} |w(n)|² by Δ ∑_{i∈S} |s_i|².
claims.review: Checked positive-ray slit-plane inclusion on [x, x + 1], monotonicity n^(−Re z − 1) ≤ n^(−1) ≤ U^(−1) for n ≥ U ≥ 1 and Re z > 0, Gram conjugation G_{j,i} = conj(G_{i,j}), and zero/positive case split on ∑_{i∈S} |s_i|².

claims.title: Prime-power divisor majorant, dyadic coefficient-square monotone bound, and explicit binary-logarithm absorption thresholds
claims.hypotheses: Real exponent ε > 0 with A = max(1, 1/(ε log 2)), K = ⌈2^(1/ε)⌉, and D = A^K, specialized to ε = 1/400, σ₀ = 399/400, and C = D² = A^(2K); integers n ≥ 1, U ≥ 1, and nonnegative cutoffs Y, N ≥ 0 with truncated Möbius convolution a(n) = ∑_{d e = n, 1 ≤ d ≤ Y, 1 ≤ e ≤ N} μ(d) and weighted coefficients b(n) = a(n) n^(−σ₀) (plus modulus q ≥ 1, Dirichlet character χ mod q, s ∈ ℂ, 1 ≤ Y ≤ N, and R ≥ Y N for the polynomial product identity); and real box height Q ≥ Q₀ ≥ 20 with dyadic cutoffs X = ⌈Q⌉, Y = X⁴, J = 8(⌊log₂ X⌋ + 1), N = 2^J, and block scales U = Y 2^j (0 ≤ j < J).
claims.statement: For every ε > 0 and integer n ≥ 1, τ(n) ≤ D n^ε; for all integers Y, N ≥ 0, |a(n)| ≤ τ(n) (with a(1) = 1 when Y, N ≥ 1, and (∑_{1≤e≤N} χ(e)e^(−s))(∑_{1≤d≤Y} μ(d)χ(d)d^(−s)) = 1 + ∑_{Y<n≤R} a(n)χ(n)n^(−s) when 1 ≤ Y ≤ N and R ≥ Y N), and at ε = 1/400 and σ₀ = 399/400 all integers Y, N ≥ 0 and U ≥ 1 obey ∑_{U<n≤2U} |b(n)|² ≤ C U^(−99/100) ≤ C U^(−197/200); and for any C ≥ 0 there exist Q₀ ≥ 20 and C₁ = 1 + 8 C · 1048576^(3/200) > 0 such that every Q ≥ Q₀ satisfies J ≤ 32 log Q, Y N ≤ 1048576 Q¹², 8 C Q³ U^(−197/200) ≤ 1/(8 J²) for all 0 ≤ j < J, and 1 + J · 8 J² C (Y N)^(3/200) ≤ C₁ Q^(1/4).
definitions: divisor majorant constants A = max(1, 1/(ε log 2)), K = ⌈2^(1/ε)⌉, D = A^K, and squared block constant C = D² at ε = 1/400
weighted Möbius convolution coefficient b(n) = a(n) n^(−399/400) on (U, 2U]
dyadic window cutoffs X = ⌈Q⌉, Y = X⁴, J = 8(⌊log₂ X⌋ + 1), N = 2^J, and assembled prefactor C₁ = 1 + 8 C · 1048576^(3/200)
